name: DimAgent Desktop
description: Status hooks for the DimAgent desktop client. Separate from the Rust alpha dima integration.

setup.instructions: Install the managed copy with the desktop-compatible dim CLI, then reload DimAgent.

events.description: Initialize activity for a DimAgent desktop session.
Show working when a desktop prompt starts.
Show idle when the desktop reply stops.
Restore working after a tool completes or approval is answered.
Show working before a desktop tool runs.
Show waiting when the desktop requests permission.
Keep working while the desktop compacts context.
Restore working after desktop context compaction.
Clear a child session when its agent finishes.

integration.removalInstructions: Remove agent-discord-presence-desktop using DimAgent desktop plugin management, then reload the client.

zh-CN.Initialize activity for a DimAgent deskt: 初始化 DimAgent 桌面会话的活动状态。
zh-CN.Show working when a desktop prompt start: 桌面端开始处理提示词时显示工作中。
桌面端回复停止时显示空闲。
zh-CN.Restore working after a tool completes o: 工具完成或审批得到答复后恢复工作状态。
桌面端执行工具前显示工作中。
zh-CN.Show waiting when the desktop requests p: 桌面端请求权限时显示等待确认。
zh-CN.Keep working while the desktop compacts: 桌面端压缩上下文时保持工作状态。
zh-CN.Restore working after desktop context co: 桌面端压缩上下文后恢复工作状态。
zh-CN.Clear a child session when its agent fin: 子智能体结束时清理其会话活动。
zh-CN.Install the managed copy with the deskto: 使用桌面端兼容的 dim CLI 安装托管副本，然后重新加载 DimAgent。
zh-CN.Remove agent-discord-presence-desktop us: 请通过 DimAgent 桌面端插件管理移除 agent-discord-presence-desktop，然后重新加载客户端。
zh-CN.Status hooks for the DimAgent desktop cl: DimAgent 桌面端的状态钩子。与 Rust alpha dima 集成独立。
